role: KI-Plattform-Experte (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Data Science und LLM Engineering
notes: Found by job-scout; Hannover; contact Moritz Witte; up to €80,400; gaps Databricks/platform ops, governance; German likely needed (B1)
apply_hint: Apply online via sparda-h.de/karriere (the posting says online only). Contact: Moritz Witte, Bereichsleiter Künstliche Intelligenz, 0511 3018-4610, moritz.witte@sparda-h.de.
verdict: Unusually good match on the two technical halves they want together: classic ML for forecasting and time series (Cognizant EV load forecasting, Covestro time-series prediction) and generative AI (multi-agent LLM systems, RAG, vector databases, semantic search, MCP), plus Python, Git, CI/CD and Azure. Gaps: building and operating an AI development platform (Databricks or similar), governance/standards for in-house AI development, banking domain.

form_fields.label: Why Sparda-Bank Hannover?
form_fields.value: You build AI in-house where no standard product fits, with standards and governance, and the role combines forecasting and LLM engineering, which is exactly my background.

form_fields.label: Salary expectation
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (posting states up to €80,400 under the tariff). Must be above the EU Blue Card threshold.

questions.q: How would you build our AI platform?
questions.a: Start small and modular: shared environment for ML and GenAI (Databricks or Azure-native), Git-based development with CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, evaluation sets per use case, human approval before go-live, monitoring, clear standards for in-house development. Evidence: GitLab CI/CD, AWS CDK, Azure, ground-truth evaluation, Expert Interface approvals.

questions.q: Tell us about a forecasting model you built.
questions.a: Cognizant EV load: ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet, XGBoost, LSTM; LSTM 96% test accuracy. Covestro: RF/XGBoost/LSTM on sensor time series, lag/rolling features, Streamlit dashboard.

questions.q: When would you build instead of buy?
questions.a: When no standard product fits the data or the process; Kniit second stream: deterministic pipeline cut a $200k projected LLM budget to near zero.
